summary: Nuveen Multi-Market Income Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose changes to its investment policies and portfolio contents, effective April 30, 2026. The modifications remove certain investment-grade requirements and adjust definitions from total assets to managed assets for high-yield investments. The filing is a routine policy update, not a special situation event, as it does not involve any acquisition, divestiture, activism, tender, restructuring, or other transformative corporate action.
